issues: Three small 270° dials sat side by side in a pale card, each only ~8% of the frame wide; ticks and needles were too thin to read
The title was debug text (NEEDLE SWEEP SELF-TEST) and the card header was a grey skeleton bar with no content
The 30px-class values only popped in after settling; no readout during the self-test, so the 'light the full range first' ritual was weak
Light grey stage, white card and thin orange needles with no light or material: it read as a widget screenshot, not a launch-film shot
changes: Graphite look (dark charcoal with a champagne-gold accent) in a cockpit layout: a central R322 dial flanked by two R222 dials angled ±16° inward; the cluster spans ~80% of the frame

Precision-instrument dials: concentric gradient faces with a glass crescent, a hairline bezel that traces 270° on ignition, ticks that light up as the needle sweeps past, and a redline that flares at full scale

Outer tapered needles around a centre readout disc: 14f snap sweep to full scale, a 3f hang, then a spring return with damping solved from the travel (~7° single overshoot), plus a sector motion smear at speed
The centre readout (148px / 92px) tracks the needle live (dim during the test, reading full scale at the top), then turns bright and pops 1.12→1 with a gold unit on settle; dials stagger 4f as a wave
Copy for a fictional Sable inference node: kicker plus a SELF-TEST breathing dot that becomes 'All systems nominal' rising word by word; the cluster drifts 1.0→1.03 during the hold
140f → 150f: 0–28 ignition, 16–44 sweep, ~52–66 dials settle in turn, 74–100 status change, 100–150 hold
